entries.title: fastp: an ultra-fast all-in-one FASTQ preprocessor
entries.summary: fastp performs FASTQ quality control, adapter trimming and quality filtering in a single multithreaded preprocessing pass.

entries.title: RdRp-scan: A bioinformatic resource to identify and annotate divergent RNA viruses in metagenomic sequence data
entries.summary: RdRp-scan uses curated RNA-dependent RNA polymerase HMM profiles to identify and annotate divergent RNA-virus sequences.

entries.title: CheckV assesses the quality and completeness of metagenome-assembled viral genomes
entries.summary: CheckV estimates completeness of single-contig viral genomes and identifies host contamination using reference comparisons and viral gene content.

entries.title: ICTV Master Species List 2025 MSL41.v1
entries.source: International Committee on Taxonomy of Viruses
entries.summary: MSL41.v1 is the official ICTV 2025 taxonomy release and is the authoritative release used to interpret current virus taxon names.

entries.title: ICTV Virus Properties: Orthomyxoviridae
entries.source: International Committee on Taxonomy of Viruses, 2025 release
entries.summary: Orthomyxoviridae are enveloped negative-sense single-stranded RNA viruses with segmented genomes and vertebrate or invertebrate hosts.

entries.title: NCBI Taxonomy: Influenza A virus
entries.summary: NCBI taxid 11320 is Influenza A virus and its displayed lineage includes Orthomyxoviridae and Alphainfluenzavirus.

entries.title: Minimum Information about an Uncultivated Virus Genome (MIUViG)
entries.locator: Table 2, Summary of required characteristics for each category
entries.summary: MIUViG defines high-quality draft genomes as greater than 90 percent complete with less than 5 percent contamination, while distinguishing genome fragments and finished genomes and requiring the supporting quality evidence to be reported.

entries.title: Workflow 2 RdRp profile coverage rule
entries.summary: Workflow 2 marks an RdRp HMM profile match valid when Profile_cov is at least 0.50.

entries.title: Workflow 2 NR family voting rule
entries.summary: Workflow 2 performs family voting among classified NR hits whose bit score is greater than 75 percent of the best classified bit score.
